# MVP and Roadmap Note

## Proposed MVP

- Session creation, publication, update, and cancellation.
- Search by topic, date, delivery mode, and location.
- Place request, withdrawal, manager approval, and status tracking.
- Capacity visibility for coordinators.
- Essential notifications.
- Attendance-list export.
- Basic administration, support diagnostics, and audit history.
- Two user-facing languages.

## Explicitly Outside the MVP

- External learners.
- Payments.
- Course-content authoring.
- Skills assessment.
- Learning recommendations.
- Native mobile applications.

## Future Ideas

- Waiting lists.
- Calendar synchronization.
- Automated reminders.
- Learning paths.
- Recommendation features.
- External learner access.
- Participation analytics.

Future ideas are not approved commitments. MVP approval is still required from
the future product owner and sponsor.
